entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: nested native-histogram count/group input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: lowerExpHistogramCountFamily is the sole caller and invokes this reducer only after countOrGroupOverExpHistogramValue admits the operand and lowerExpHistogramValuedShape lowers that same operand. A successful matched histogram lowerer publishes SampleKindHistogram, so another kind is an internal postcondition failure.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: %s is not count/group
entries.rationale: lowerExpHistogramCountFamily reaches this reducer only through countOrGroupOverExpHistogramValue, which admits exactly parser.COUNT and parser.GROUP. The default branch therefore represents an internal caller-contract violation and cannot be selected by a parsed query.

guard: past returning if kind := input.RowType().SampleKind(); kind != chplan.SampleKindHistogram
default of switch agg.Op over [case parser.COUNT; case parser.GROUP; default]
